prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Troubleshooter Screen Before Finish: Add a new desktop rendering verification screen right before home intro to ensure the app window and mascot rendering engine work without system permission blocks.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_check": {"headline": "Verify Desktop Display Compatibility", "body": "Let us quickly check if desktop overlays and pet animations are permitted on your monitor.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Desktop Overlay Support Check", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stamp Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen layout into a stage layout featuring an official adoption certificate badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Certificate", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend: Move sign-in screen immediately after pick_friend so users establish their account context right after picking their pet companion.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Multi Pet Selection Flow on Pick Friend: Transform the pick_friend screen into a carousel layout flow with interactive companion choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select your main desktop companion", "style": "large"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sign-In Clarification: Add an account hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores previous desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into an existing account will automatically restore all your previously created desktop pets."}}
5: [adoption, layout] Compact Layout for Photo Upload Screen: Change upload_photos screen to compact layout to streamline the photo submission process.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "body": "Upload 1 to 3 clear photos of your pet or favorite character for AI mascot generation."}}
6: [finish, hint] Home Intro Control Action Hint: Add an explicit control hint on home_intro explaining how to click, drag, and open settings for the desktop mascot.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Left-click your mascot on the desktop to interact, drag to move, and right-click to open pet settings anytime."}}
7: [choose_path, redesign] Full Bleed Layout Redesign for Story Screen: Redesign the story screen using a full_bleed layout with prominent mascot visual graphics.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "style": "large"}]}}}
8: [home, wait_info] Tip Carousel Component on Waiting Screen: Add a calm tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining background mascot behavior while generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Your pet will live right on your desktop border once ready.", "style": "calm"}]}}
9: [sign_in, new_screen] New Account Verification Helper Screen in Sign-In: Insert a new account helper screen right before sign-in to help returning users distinguish between restoring pets and fresh account creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_help", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_account_help": {"headline": "Welcome Back or New Friend?", "body": "Select whether you are logging in to restore existing desktop pets or creating a brand new companion account.", "layout": "card"}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a display verification screen before home intro, which is permitted under rule 4.
Redesigns adoption certificate with an official badge while retaining its required function.
Reorders sign-in after pick_friend, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Redesigns pick_friend into a carousel layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Adds account sign-in restoration hint without violating copy or fair design rules.
Updates photo upload screen to compact layout while maintaining photo upload job.
Adds control hint to home intro screen within allowed onboarding modifications.
Redesigns story screen with full-bleed mascot graphic while preserving pet introduction function.
Adds a calm tip carousel component to the waiting screen as permitted in onboarding.
Inserts a valid helper screen before sign-in while preserving all required onboarding steps.
